description: Community-maintained MLB National League injury database tracking updates for NL stars.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

injury_history.details: Tore right ACL two days before the 2021 All-Star break; missed remainder of 2021 season.
Tore left ACL near the end of May 2024; limited 2024 season to 49 games (.250/.324/.420, 4 HR, 15 RBI, 16 SB).
Strained left hamstring; had initially returned from a milder hamstring strain on May 19 but re-aggravated it. Hit .251 with 7 HR, 15 SB, .793 OPS in 53 games in 2025 before being placed on the IL.

rehab_timeline.details: Began Spring Training at NARF. Doing regular batting practice, throwing, and running drills in a straight line, but not yet cleared for cutting drills. Hitting long home runs in cage.
Traveled to Los Angeles for final medical clearances from doctors to build up running and begin a rehab assignment.
Expected to begin outfield work and cutting/stopping/starting in the coming days. Rehab assignment likely to begin around the All-Star break.
Expected to begin Minor League rehab assignment during the All-Star break; anticipated return shortly after.

players.return_status: Returned to Atlanta Braves leadoff spot for 2026 season; confirmed by manager Walt Weiss on Feb 22, 2026. Launched a baseball at 112.4 mph in his first spring training appearance. Currently batting .251 with 7 HR and 22 RBI in 53 games; leading the NL in stolen bases at 35 SB.
players.notes: Two surgically repaired knees. Career production when healthy: .275/.394/.462 with 25 HR and 25 SB since 2023. 2023 MVP season featured a 40-70 campaign (41 HR, 73 SB). At age 28 in 2026, Acuña has already surpassed his 2025 MLB IL stint totals and is on pace for a healthy, productive season. Braves are 55-40 and fighting for the NL East lead.

players.name: Mookie Betts
players.status: Active — recovered from oblique strain, 2026 season underway

injury_history.details: Required a two-week IL stint. Betts noted his current oblique injury is less severe than that prior experience.
Fractured a toe on his left foot, which caused him to miss a handful of games at the end of May 2025.
Lost approximately 18 pounds in two weeks during spring training and into the start of the 2025 season. Contributed to a significant offensive slump.
Temporary absence from the team in July 2025 following the death of his stepfather.

rehab_timeline.details: Placed on 10-day IL with right oblique strain after exiting game vs. Washington Nationals. Hyeseong Kim recalled from Triple-A to take his spot.
Betts reported feeling 'light years ahead' of expected recovery. Dodged playing again for the next couple of days.
Suffered a minor setback — felt soreness after beginning on-field batting practice. Dodgers transferred him to cage work temporarily. Reported feeling he has 'turned a corner.'
Minor League rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City; completed a two-game rehab stint.
Activated from IL; returned to Dodgers lineup Monday against the Giants after a five-week absence.
Betts stated his oblique is 'behind him' and does not require ongoing monitoring. Confirmed as healthy and ready for any role.

players.return_status: Returned to the Dodgers' lineup on May 12, 2026 after a five-week absence from a right oblique strain. In his first three games back, went 2-for-13 with a HR. Says oblique won't need monitoring going forward. Currently batting .235 with 11 HR and 31 RBI in 60 games (including pre-injury games). Lost about 2 mph on bat speed over the past three years (71.3 → 69.0 mph). Career lows from 2025: .258 AVG, .732 OPS, 104 OPS+.
players.notes: Former 2018 NL MVP. Oblique injuries are notoriously finicky; the Dodgers' cautious approach reflects lessons from Max Muncy's back-to-back oblique injuries. Dodgers play Betts at #3 in the lineup in 2026 (behind Ohtani and ahead of Freeman) to accommodate Kyle Tucker batting second. Betts has the most World Series rings (4) of any active player. 2026 Dodgers are 61-36 and leading the NL West.

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active — managing chronic ankle issues, performing above expectations in 2026

injury_history.details: Chronic ankle problems that have affected his speed. Postseason ankle injury in 2024 led to surgery. Ongoing management of the ankle condition.
Required a two-week IL stint. Betts noted his current oblique injury is less severe than that prior experience.

rehab_timeline.details: Ankle surgery in early December 2024 for bone bruise and sprain from the 2024 postseason.

At Dodgers FanFest, Freeman stated he has yet to begin running but expressed confidence in being ready for the regular season opener (March 18, 2025 in Tokyo). Not expected to be ready for initial Cactus League games.
Played in 2025 World Series for the Dodgers, hitting a home run in Game 7 against the Blue Jays. Demonstrated his health was sufficient for postseason play.
Reports emerged that Freeman was set to undergo additional procedures ahead of the 2026 season. Andrew Friedman initially disputed the need, but subsequent reports confirmed surgery was planned.
In Spring Training for 2026 season, managing ankle health under Dave Roberts' guidance to limit wear.
Was noted as struggling with an offensive drought (only 4 HR at that time). Subsequent news suggests Freeman recovered and is now producing well.
Freeman has bounced back strongly, posting production well above his early-season struggles. With 15 HR and 49 RBI in 94 games, he is performing at a strong pace despite chronic ankle management.

players.return_status: Active for 2026 season. Despite chronic ankle issues, Freeman is performing at an elite level — batting .290 with 15 HR, 49 RBI, and a 138 wRC+ in 94 games. This is a remarkable bounce-back from the 2025 season's ankle-related struggles. Batting cleanup in the Dodgers' lineup behind Ohtani and Betts. Braves' leadoff setup poses a defensive challenge for the Dodgers but their offensive production more than compensates.
players.notes: 2024 World Series MVP. One of the premier first basemen in MLB. His ankle has been a recurring issue affecting speed and power. Dave Roberts is managing his workload to keep him healthy for a 2026 championship push. Career .331/.429/.545 in 2022 and .282/.378/.476 in 2023. With 15 HR in 94 games through July 12, he's on pace for a 30+ HR season if his ankle holds up. The Dodgers are 61-36 and leading the NL West.

source_notes.acuna_stats: 2026 season stats through July 12, 2026 via StatMuse; game log through June 9, 2026. 35 SB is NL-leading.
source_notes.betts_stats: 2026 season stats through July 12, 2026 via StatMuse. Returned from oblique strain on May 12, 2026 (activated after 5-week absence). Currently batting .235 with 11 HR, 31 RBI in 60 games.
source_notes.freeman_stats: 2026 season stats through July 12, 2026 via StatMuse. Despite early-season ankle struggles, has rebounded strongly with 15 HR and 49 RBI in 94 games (138 wRC+).
source_notes.general: All stats sourced from StatMuse, MLB.com, ESPN, Dodgers Beat, and other MLB media outlets. Data last verified July 13, 2026.
